ruleDefinitions.name: Potentially Suspicious Child Process Of VsCode
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects uncommon or suspicious child processes spawning from a VsCode "code.exe" process. This could indicate an attempt of persistence via VsCode tasks or terminal profiles.

sequences.query: parent_process_path = RGX("\\\\code\\\.exe$") AND ((process_path = RGX("\\\\calc\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\regsvr32\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\rundll32\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\cscript\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\wscript\\\.exe$")) OR ((process_path = RGX("\\\\powershell\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\pwsh\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\cmd\\\.exe$")) AND (process_command_line = RGX(".*Invoke\\-Expressions.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*IEX.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*Invoke\\-Command.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*ICM.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*DownloadString.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*rundll32.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*regsvr32.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*wscript.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*cscript.*"))) OR (process_path = RGX(".*\\:\\\\Users\\\\Public\\\\.*") OR process_path = RGX(".*\\:\\\\Windows\\\\Temp\\\\.*") OR process_path = RGX(".*\\:\\\\Temp\\\\.*")))
